replacements.Un eval set fiable no nace al guardar ej: A trustworthy eval set is not created by saving examples to JSONL. Each item needs provenance, a split unit that preserves dependencies, and an explicit role. Dev, regression, holdout, and challenge are not four names for the same bank. The release used for comparison stays frozen; new failures feed the next version.

replacements.Ciclo de vida versionado de un eval set: Versioned lifecycle of an offline eval set
replacements.Los casos candidatos pasan por provenanc: Candidate cases pass through provenance and eligibility checks, then through a grouping unit that prevents dependent items from being split apart, and are finally assigned to banks with different roles: development, regression, frozen holdout, or rotating challenge. Admitted items live inside a release with a manifest and hash. A hard-positive/hard-negative pair changes one causal condition while keeping the rest approximately constant. Four separate risk channels show training exposure, cross-split leakage, development leakage, and temporal leakage. Production failures feed the next version rather than mutating the current release.

replacements.primero decide qué unidad no puede cruza: first decide which unit must not cross splits, then assign each case to a bank with an explicit role and freeze the release with a reproducible manifest. A useful hard negative tests a concrete boundary. An overlap scanner helps investigate leakage, but it does not prove the model never saw the content. New failures enter the next version instead of rewriting history.
